> 第9章 她没在家（第1页）
程源冷下了脸，觉得容辞是仗着自己身份搞特殊化：“容秘书，请你摆正你的工作态度，你以为这里是你家吗？！”
容辞提起包包，态度依旧：“你要是有所不满，可以现在就辞退我。”
之前他跟着封庭深去了a国，但容辞已经递了辞呈的事，他却也是知道的。
虽说他深得封庭深信任，可公司不是他的一言堂，他没这么大的权利说让容辞滚就让容辞滚。
更何况容辞在封老太太那很得脸，如果容辞去那边告状，就算他敢肯定封庭深会力保他，他也讨不了便宜。
姜哲看他脸色不对，问道：“发生什么事了？”
他忍不住说道：“这不像是容辞能做出来的事，其中是不是有什么误会？”
“没有误会，过程就是这样，依我看容辞就是在仗着自己的身份搞特殊化，哪里有你平时说的这么好？”
姜哲顿了下：“可能是要辞职了，开始摆烂了？”
可容辞最近工作还是很积极的啊，跟过去没什么两样。
这时，封庭深从不远处走了过来：“发生什么事了？”
“就是容秘书，她工作还没做完就下班了。”
“你要觉得不满，走程序辞退她就是了。”
倒不是他们觉得封庭深对容辞的事过于冷漠。
而是听封庭深这意思，他似乎根本不知道容辞已经递了辞呈？
他们正想说话，封庭深的手机就响了起来。
封庭深没再看他们，一边越过他们朝电梯走去，一边接起电话：“我现在下班，一会就到……”
毕竟，封庭深对容辞的事向来都不上心。

之前只要封景心在家，容辞回容家时，容辞基本上都会带上女儿一起回去。
可现在，封景心虽然回了国，但这么多天了，她却一次电话都没给她打过，反而天天给林芜打电话，几天不见林芜就想得不行。
再说了，现在封景心和林芜关系这么亲近，要是老太太知道了，不知道要气成什么样。
所以，这次回容家，哪怕封景心回国了，她也没有去封庭深那边接她，而是一个人回的容家。
路上有点堵，容辞到容家时，已经下午六点多了。
容老太太看到她，笑容一顿，有些心疼的摸了摸她的脸：“瘦了。”
容辞眼睫微闪，说道：“最近工作忙。”
老太太叹气：“再忙也要好好吃饭啊。”

Mr. Feng, my wife has wanted to divorce you for a long time. Latest chapter_Chapter 9 She is not at home. Page 1_Mr. Feng, my wife has wanted to divorce you for a long time. Yun Zhongmi_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 9 She is not at home (Page 1)
Cheng Yuan's face turned cold, feeling that Rong Ci was relying on his status to be special: "Secretary Rong, please correct your work attitude. Do you think this is your home?!"
Rong Ci raised the bag, but his attitude remained the same: "If you are dissatisfied, you can fire me now."
He followed Feng Tingshen to Country A before, but he also knew that Rong Ci had submitted his resignation.
Although he was deeply trusted by Feng Ting, the company was not his alone, and he did not have such a big right to tell Rong Ci to leave.
What's more, Rong Ci was very popular with Mrs. Feng. If Rong Ci complained there, even if he was sure that Feng Tingshen would protect him, he wouldn't be able to get any advantage.
Jiang Zhe saw something wrong with his expression and asked, "What happened?"
He couldn't help but said: "This doesn't seem like something Rong Ci can do. Is there any misunderstanding in it?"
"No misunderstanding, the process is like this. In my opinion, Rong Ci is relying on his own identity to become special. How can he be as good as you usually say?"
Jiang Zhe paused for a moment: "Maybe he is resigning and starting to mess up?"
But Rongci has been very active in work recently, no different from the past.
At this time, Feng Tingshen came over from not far away: "What happened?"
"It's Secretary Rong. She got off work before she finished her work."
"If you feel dissatisfied, just follow the procedure and fire her."
It's not that they think Feng Tingshen is too indifferent to Rong Ci.
But hearing what Feng Tingshen meant, it seemed that he didn't even know that Rong Ci had submitted his resignation?
Just as they were about to talk, Feng Tingshen's cell phone rang.
Feng Tingshen didn't look at them anymore. He walked past them towards the elevator and answered the phone: "I'm off work now. I'll be there in a minute..."
After all, Feng Tingshen never cared about Rong Ci.
In the past, whenever Feng Jingxin was at home and Rong Ci returned to Rong Ci's house, Rong Ci would basically take his daughter back with him.
But now, although Feng Jingxin has returned to China, she has not called her once for so many days. Instead, she calls Lin Wu every day. She can't think of anything after not seeing Lin Wu for a few days.
Besides, Feng Jingxin and Lin Wu are so close now. If the old lady knew about it, I don't know how angry she would be.
Therefore, when she returned to the Rong family this time, even if Feng Jingxin returned to China, she did not go to Feng Tingshen to pick her up, but went back to the Rong family alone.
There was a bit of traffic on the road, and when Rong Ci arrived at Rong's house, it was already past six o'clock in the afternoon.
When Old Mrs. Rong saw her, she smiled and touched her face with some distress: "I've lost weight."
Rong Ci's eyelashes flickered and he said, "I've been busy with work lately."
The old lady sighed: "No matter how busy you are, you still have to eat well."
